title: Re-landing an item that already landed
description: A pull request opened for an item that already landed is a re-land attempt. The item keeps its current landing until the observer sees the attempt merge; an attempt that closes unmerged closes with its reason, and an armed one still sends its holder the stopped-landing notice. Board label, fleet landings, readiness and the waiting worker describe the open attempt; the item read shows it under merge_queue.attempt.
